easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Cloudshift.
description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Cloudshift, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Cloudshift, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
